summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of CloudBite Kitchen (admin/manager/customer/delivery). 26/26 backend pytest tests passed (1 skipped where no foreign order existed). Customer end-to-end mobile flow works (login -> menu -> cart -> checkout with Leaflet map pin -> COD order placed -> 3-stage tracker shown). Delivery portal login works. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: staff console sidebar navigation is broken - NavLinks use relative paths so clicking any sidebar item after the first accumulates the URL (e.g. /console/orders/menu) and falls through the catch-all route back to Dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: NavLink `to={n.to}` uses relative paths ("orders", "menu", etc.). Once user navigates from /console to /console/orders, clicking any other sidebar item resolves relative and produces /console/orders/menu, /console/orders/menu/deliveries, etc. These deep URLs match the `path='*'` fallback in StaffApp routes and silently render <Dashboard/>. Result: after the first sidebar click, all subsequent sidebar navigations appear broken (page reverts to Dashboard, active highlight stays on Dashboard).

issues: Recharts warning in console: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Cosmetic but appears twice on load; wrap Orders-by-status chart in a container with explicit min-height or use ResponsiveContainer with aspect.

3-stage labels are Title Case ('Order Being Prepared', 'Order On The Way', 'Order Arrived') while spec requested ALL CAPS ('ORDER BEING PREPARED / ON THE WAY / ARRIVED'). Semantically equivalent; only cosmetic.

action_items: Fix StaffLayout NavLink to use absolute paths (e.g., `to={\`/console/${n.to}\`}` and `to="/console"` for Dashboard) OR wrap routes in a nested layout route so relative NavLinks resolve to /console/*. Currently, navigating between staff console pages after the first click is broken and lands on Dashboard.
(Optional) Adjust customer order tracker labels to exactly match spec ('ORDER BEING PREPARED', 'ORDER ON THE WAY', 'ORDER ARRIVED').
(Optional) Fix Recharts container width warnings on admin Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffLayout uses relative NavLink `to` values which combined with `path='*'` fallback breaks navigation silently after first click - critical UX bug.
Backend seed correctly rewrites admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes (good). All routes properly exclude _id via serialize().
Cart merges customizations by canonical key (good).
routes_orders.py ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS correctly enforces the state machine and returns 400 on invalid moves.
Delivery lifecycle correctly deletes live location on delivered (good) and stores partner_location during OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (verified).

If main agent fixes StaffLayout NavLink bug, retest by logging into /console as admin, then click Orders -> Menu -> Deliveries -> Managers -> Settings and verify each URL is exactly /console/<page> (no accumulation) and correct page content renders. Also verify menu availability toggle via Radix switch (role='switch' aria-checked) works and persists. Consider also verifying customer-stage label capitalization matches spec.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/portals/staff/StaffLayout.jsx line 36 `to={n.to}` where n.to is 'orders', 'menu', etc. React Router v6 treats these as relative to the current URL, so /console/orders + click 'menu' -> /console/orders/menu. StaffApp.jsx has routes `path='orders'`, `path='menu'`, etc. and a catch-all `path='*'` that renders <Dashboard/>, so nested URLs silently render Dashboard while the sidebar highlight also reverts to Dashboard. Fix: use `to={\`/console/${n.to}\`}` for children and `to="/console"` for the Dashboard item (with end=true).
